data.define: To study many things quickly just before a test.

misuse.why: Cramming only works for short tests.

native.tip: “cram” = belajar mendadak. Contoh: “I must cram for math.”
native.caption:
Apa arti “cram”?

Contoh: “I must cram for math.” (Aku harus "cram" untuk matematika.)
